powers.name: Throw a star (Magic Missile, level 5)
powers.text: Pull off a star: cast Magic Missile as a level 5 spell.

powers.name: Enter the Astral Plane

params.text: flickers toward the Astral Plane, but Barovia's mists hold fast

powers.text: Magic action: you and what you wear go to the Astral Plane (the Mists of Barovia hold you fast).

summary: +1 to saving throws; six stars to throw as level 5 Magic Missiles (they return at dusk).
text: This black or dark-blue robe is embroidered with small white or silver stars. You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws while you wear it. Six stars, located on the robe's upper front portion, are particularly large. While wearing this robe, you can take a Magic action to pull off one of the stars and use it to cast the level 5 version of Magic Missile. Daily at dusk, 1d6 removed stars reappear on the robe. While you wear the robe, you can take a Magic action to enter the Astral Plane along with everything you are wearing and carrying. You remain there until you take a Magic action to return to the plane you were on.
